data.name: Abasin
data.gender_notes: Abasin is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'abasa', meaning 'to serve' or 'to be a slave to'. The name Abasin signifies one who is devoted to Allah, a true servant of the Divine. In Islamic history, many great figures have borne this name, reminding us of the importance of servitude to Allah in our daily lives. The name Abasin carries the meaning “Servant of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abasin usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for someone who is deeply devoted to Allah and is always ready to serve Him.
data.etymology: Abasin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of Allah.”
